title: Plural

learn.heading: Five ways to make a plural
learn.text: German nouns form the plural in several ways, and there is no perfect rule: learn each plural **together with the noun**, like *der Tisch, die Tische*. The article in the plural is always **die**. Some vowels (**a, o, u, au**) often get an **umlaut** (ä, ö, ü, äu) in the plural. The dictionary shows the plural after the noun, for example *Stuhl, ¨-e*.

examples.de: Die Wohnung hat zwei Zimmer und einen Balkon.
examples.en: The apartment has two rooms and a balcony.

examples.de: Wir brauchen vier Stühle für den Tisch.
examples.en: We need four chairs for the table.

examples.de: In meiner WG gibt es drei Betten.
examples.en: In my flat share there are three beds.

learn.heading: Patterns that help
learn.text: Some endings tell you the plural. **Feminine nouns** almost always take **-n or -en**: *die Küche → die Küchen, die Tür → die Türen, die Wohnung → die Wohnungen*. Nouns ending in **-er, -el, -en** (masculine or neuter) usually do not change: *das Zimmer, der Schlüssel, das Fenster*. Words from other languages often take **-s**: *das Sofa, das Hotel, das Handy*. Masculine nouns most often take **-e**, often with an umlaut.

examples.de: Die Schlüssel liegen auf dem Tisch.
examples.en: The keys are on the table.

examples.de: Wie viele Zimmer hat die Wohnung?
examples.en: How many rooms does the apartment have?

learn.heading: Plural in sentences
learn.text: After a number (above one) the noun is plural: *zwei Zimmer, drei Betten*. There is no plural of **ein**, so the plural of *ein Zimmer* is just *Zimmer*: *Ich suche Zimmer in Aachen.* The verb must also be plural: *Die Möbel sind neu.* Watch out: **Möbel** is always plural in this sense (*das Möbelstück* is one piece of furniture).

examples.de: Wir suchen zwei Zimmer in der Nähe von der Uni.
examples.en: We are looking for two rooms near the university.

examples.de: Die Möbel in der Wohnung sind alt, aber gut.
examples.en: The furniture in the apartment is old, but good.

tip: Make Anki cards that show the plural on the answer side ("der Stuhl – die Stühle"). Never learn a noun without its plural: it is one extra word on the card, but it saves you from guessing for years.

exercises.q: In der WG gibt es drei ___. (Bett)

exercises.explain: Feminine nouns ending in -e take -n: die Lampen.
Nouns ending in -el stay the same in the plural.

exercises.q: What is the plural of "das Haus"?
exercises.explain: Haus takes -er plus an umlaut: die Häuser.

exercises.q: What is the plural of "das Sofa"?
exercises.explain: Words from other languages often take -s: die Sofas.

exercises.q: Which article do ALL plural nouns take?
exercises.explain: In the plural the article is always die: die Tische, die Betten.
Balkon is masculine: der Balkon, die Balkone.
Learn each plural together with the noun; there is no perfect rule.
Subject, verb in position 2, then the object.

exercises.en: The apartment has three rooms and two balconies.
answer: Die Wohnung hat drei Zimmer und zwei Balkone
exercises.explain: Zimmer stays Zimmer, Balkon → Balkone. After a number the noun is plural.
